mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has crossed from -1.0 to +2.4 over three weekly means while RETAIL_REC sits near its trough at -19.3; transit-station throughput leads discretionary trip generation by roughly two weeks, so sustained positive TRANSIT pulls RETAIL_REC upward over the coming month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's mean over the next 28 days is at or below its last-28-day mean of -21.6 while TRANSIT remains above 0 in every week of the horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A single-week collapse in WORKPLACES mobility from -2.3 to -11.0 removes the commuter and office-district footfall that weekday discretionary retail depends on, depressing RETAIL_REC within one week of the crossing.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 5 points week-on-week (observed -2.3 to -11.0)
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES dropped 8.7 points between t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: In the week after a WORKPLACES drop greater than 5 points week-on-week, RETAIL_REC rises instead of falling relative to its prior-week mean.

regime_hint: household-provisioning regime with elevated home time
failure_condition: In weeks where GROCERY_PHARM exceeds +10 and RESIDENTIAL exceeds +5, the following 14-day RETAIL_REC mean is higher than the preceding 14-day mean.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds -21.6 while PARKS stays below -18 in every week of the horizon.
